    Projective objects at a covered weight #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_semistable_projective_quotient_of_retract (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hP : P.IsPresilting) (Q : TwoTerm R) (hb : Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential))) (hQ : ∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), Function.Surjective ⇑(P.precompose M) → Function.Surjective ⇑(Q.precompose M)) {D : FGModuleCat R} (s : D ⟶ CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential) (r : CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel Q.differential ⟶ D) (hs : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp s r = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id D) :
    ∃ (G : FGModuleCat R) (p : D ⟶ G), CategoryTheory.Epi p ∧ (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable G ∧ (∀ {M : FGModuleCat R}, (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable M → ∀ (f : D ⟶ M), ∃ (g : G ⟶ M), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp p g = f) ∧ (∀ {M N : FGModuleCat R} (q : M ⟶ N) [CategoryTheory.Epi q], (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable M → (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable N → ∀ (f : G ⟶ N), ∃ (g : G ⟶ M), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g q = f) ∧ ∀ (a : G ⟶ G), ∃ (e : D ⟶ D), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e p = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp p a

    A retract of a Bongartz cokernel has a universal semistable quotient. The quotient is projective among the semistable modules, and its endomorphisms lift to endomorphisms of the retract.

    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.exists_semistable_projective_generator (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hP : P.IsPresilting) :
    ∃ (G : FGModuleCat R), (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable G ∧ (∀ (M : FGModuleCat R), (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable M → IsGeneratedBy G M) ∧ ∀ {M N : FGModuleCat R} (q : M ⟶ N) [CategoryTheory.Epi q], (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable M → (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable N → ∀ (f : G ⟶ N), ∃ (g : G ⟶ M), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g q = f

    The semistable category at the Euler weight of a presilting complex has a finite projective generator. The generator is obtained by dividing the Bongartz cokernel by the trace of the original cokernel.
